00211318.name: Sequence::waitFrames
00211318.why: counts the running thread down on +0x1c (-1 idle): returns 1 while waiting, 0 when the count ends; flag 0x400 restarts it (seqFunc004 / 253)

002113a4.name: Sequence::jumpTo
002113a4.why: sets the VM's pending jump 0x7b47b0 = target + image base 0x7b47d0 - m_base[current image 0x7b4dd0] (Sequence +0xdc08); seqFunc000 calls it and returns 0xccccccce

002113dc.name: Sequence::execThread
002113dc.why: runs a thread at once in the record at +0xdc30 under flag 0x100 (registers saved / restored around it); queued on the start list if it waits; GamArea::checkPc calls it

00211830.name: Sequence::execImmediate
00211830.why: callEntryNow's worker: unless hasThread(id, arg), fills m_single (name imdy), optional call save, selects the image, sets flag 0x100, seqVmRun, releases or queues the rest on m_start, then selects image 2

00211be4.name: Sequence::queueSingle
00211be4.why: unless hasThread(id, arg), queues a thread on m_start at the addiu-sp entry with arg and flags; copies the name single into m_single as startThread does

00211e84.name: Sequence::startThread
00211e84.why: builds a 0xb0 thread record (id, pc = the first addiu sp of the entry, -1, 1) and appends it to the start list (+0x40) that exec moves into the image pools

002120ac.name: Sequence::queueThread
002120ac.why: builds a SeqThread (flags, id, entry rebased to the image and moved to its addiu sp, arg, name, wait -1) and appends it to m_start (+0x40); callSave != 0 sets flag 0x80 and seqVmAllocCallSave

00212330.name: Sequence::queueTrigger
00212330.why: queues a trg thread from a record (+0x2c image id, +0x30 thread id, +0x34 entry), m_area = the record; no callers

00212598.name: Sequence::queueTriggerThread
00212598.why: queues a trg thread: image and m_area from a1, id a2, entry a3, arg, flags; no callers

002127f4.name: Sequence::freeStageEntries
002127f4.why: returns the image-1 entries (top bits 1) of the entry pool +0xc3c0 to its free list, the same loop as clearStageVars without the clears

00212920.name: Sequence::addEntry
00212920.why: pops a free node of the entry pool +0xc3c0 and appends {id, value} to its used list (seqFunc110)

002129b8.name: Sequence::callEntry
002129b8.why: finds id in m_entries (addEntry's list) and queueThread(id, its value, arg, 2, callSave, none)

00212a5c.name: Sequence::callEntryNow
00212a5c.why: as callEntry but saves the VM state, runs 0x211830 at once and restores it; native 110 case 15 returns SEQ_RET_RETURN after it

00212d08.name: Sequence::endThread
00212d08.why: findThread(id, arg) then copies the thread into m_ended (+0x6200); native 110 case 99

00212e64.name: Sequence::endThreadOf
00212e64.why: endThread's twin with the lookup 0x213d90 (by another key); native 110 case 31

00212fbc.name: Sequence::endThreadsWithArg
00212fbc.why: copies every thread of the three image pools whose m_arg (+0x28) equals arg to m_ended

00213450.name: Sequence::killThreads
00213450.why: image index argument: moves the image's threads to the ended list and reaps them (calls reapThreads), Sequence::stopImages' worker

00213adc.name: Sequence::hasThreadIn
00213adc.why: scans a thread list for id (+0x4) and arg (+0x28); 1 found

00213b28.name: Sequence::findThreadIn
00213b28.why: scans a thread list for id and arg, *node gets the node; 1 found

00213b7c.name: Sequence::findThreadNamedIn
00213b7c.why: walks a node range for a thread whose m_name strcmp-equals name, stores the node

00213bfc.name: Sequence::hasThreadNamedIn
00213bfc.why: the same without storing the node

00213c6c.name: Sequence::findThread
00213c6c.why: picks the image pool by the id's top two bits (0..2, else 0) and searches it (0x213b28) for the id, returning the node through the third argument

00213d00.name: Sequence::hasThread
00213d00.why: picks the image pool of id >> 30 and calls 0x213adc

00213d90.name: Sequence::findThreadNamed
00213d90.why: findThreadNamedIn over the used lists of images 0, 1, 2; endThreadOf calls it

00213e78.name: Sequence::hasThreadNamed
00213e78.why: hasThreadNamedIn over the used lists of images 0, 1, 2; natives 004 / 152 call it

00213f48.name: Sequence::setupImage
00213f48.why: sets the VM's image registers 0x7b47d0.. from the image header (+0xc..+0x24), saves them per image at 0x7b4850 + idx * 0x30 and the register file at 0x2d9c08 + idx * 0x80

002142c0.name: seqVmIdleLoop
002142c0.why: unreferenced: two empty countdown loops 0x1ff by 0x20 (cache-line style), after setupImage

00214310.name: seqVmSelectImage
00214310.why: loads the VM image registers 0x7b47d0.. and the register file from the image idx save areas (0x7b4850 + idx * 0x30, 0x2d9c08 + idx * 0x80)

002144c4.name: seqVmSaveImage
002144c4.why: runImage's closing call with the image index: the counterpart of seqVmSelectImage

002144cc.name: seqVmLoadRecord

0022b450.name: i3rGetTexIndexByName

0022b488.name: i3rGetRootMatrix10

0022b4a0.name: i3rGetRootMatrix14

0022f9d8.name: i3mDecodeKeyPair

0022fb90.name: i3mDecodeKeySpline

00230380.name: i3mFindKey

00230470.name: i3mQuatMul
